environment_evidence: completion_runs/00/reproduction.json: macOS arm64, eight logical CPUs, Torch 2.8.0, MPS=false, CUDA=false. The delivered Linux environment and its timings are not assumed to apply.
task01_allowed: r1 contract revision, archiving, mechanical helper/structural tests and packet creation only; no repeat source browsing, benchmark, matrix-bank build, model training, NLO implementation, data upload or threshold relaxation.
future_sequence_requires_review: After task 01 approval, task 02 source/convention matching and small deterministic coefficient tests only.
After task 02 approval, task 03 full-support NLO kernel/coupling validation against an independently built pinned reference on small grids before any expensive bank.

After forward approval, pilot exactly two frozen truths x one fit seed; use wall-clock and peak resident-memory measurements to decide feasibility, not to change statistical counts or thresholds based on coverage.
Then 20 outer-dataset smoke runs, 10 per truth, for execution/failure diagnostics; their outcomes are excluded from calibration and test.

Only after another review, 80 independent calibration plus 240 independent test datasets per truth (640 total). If budget is infeasible, stop and revise prospectively; do not silently reduce n or optionally stop when coverage looks favorable.

process_limits.memory: Measure peak RSS during approved pilot; require headroom and reduce concurrency to one if needed; do not infer total RAM from logical CPU count

cache: Cache deterministic forward banks by complete hash of source revision, prescription, order, nf, alpha boundary, scales, full CFF xi/Q2/t grid and numerical resolution. The new 41+80 polynomiality xi nodes are reference-scale moment integrations, not new CFF points: they require no perturbative banks. Pilot records build wall time, peak RAM and bank size; no estimate presented as measured. Never reuse LO banks for NLO.
checkpoint_resume: For later approved fits write atomic task-scoped checkpoint with opaque outer-dataset ID, PRNG states, optimizer/profile states, source/model/objective/fixed-scale/geometry/covariance/profile-algorithm/bank hashes and software versions. Freeze applied cutoff by estimand ID plus those hashes; never key it by test truth label. Resume only on exact matching fingerprint; preserve old checkpoint on mismatch, log all attempts and timeouts.
timeouts_and_reporting: Initial pilot per-fit cap 2 hours and bank cap 4 hours; cap later batch duration from observed pilot without modifying frozen sample size. The broader 41-node fit plus 80-node diagnostics and multiple constrained profile solves increase later CPU/RAM costs without additional banks; no cost benchmark was run now. The nominal 640 final outer datasets x two starts imply at least 1,280 unrestricted optimizations before profile searches, so the campaign is not approved or budget-certified by this plan. Log SLSQP starts, bracket/refinement evaluations, certified unbounded cases and search-cap failures separately. Report measured wall time, peak RSS, cache hit rate, fit/profile failure rates and projected cost at every review gate. These are prospective caps, not results.
privacy: Source PDFs and public reference code may be fetched for verification. Raw private CFF table rows, upstream model weights and GPD checkpoints remain local and out of review packet.
